svg.title: Cormier — Sorbus domestica
svg.desc: A fruiting service-tree twig with an eleven-leaflet pinnate leaf. Narrow, finely toothed leaflets spread in five opposite pairs and one terminal blade along a curved rachis. Fine branching stalks hold small yellow and russet pear-shaped pomes with persistent starry calyxes, including one softly brown bletted fruit. Sage watercolour and sparse umber engraving describe the veins, bark and fruit skins.
